scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/client build && pnpm --dir apps/metrics-api build && pnpm --dir apps/metrics-publisher build && pnpm --dir apps/indexer-monitor build
scripts.compose:api: docker compose up --build minio minio-init metrics-api
scripts.compose:bucket:clear: docker compose run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint /bin/sh minio-init -c 'mc alias set local http://minio:9000 "$MINIO_ROOT_USER" "$MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD" && mc rm --recursive --force "local/${ARTIFACT_BUCKET:-metrics}" && mc mb -p "local/${ARTIFACT_BUCKET:-metrics}"'
scripts.compose:core: docker compose up postgres hasura indexer
scripts.compose:publish: INDEXER_DEPLOYMENT_ID=$(git rev-parse HEAD) docker compose --profile publish run --build --rm --no-deps metrics-publisher
scripts.compose:up: docker compose up --build postgres hasura minio minio-init indexer metrics-api
scripts.docker:scan: mise exec -- trivy image --image-config-scanners secret --severity MEDIUM,HIGH,CRITICAL --exit-code 1
scripts.lint:actions: mise exec --locked jactionlint -- jactionlint --profile correctness --no-online && mise exec --locked zizmor -- zizmor --offline --strict-collection --persona auditor --min-severity medium --min-confidence low --collect=workflows --collect=actions .github
scripts.test: pnpm test:root && pnpm test:artifacts && pnpm test:client && pnpm test:metrics-api && pnpm test:metrics-publisher && pnpm test:indexer && pnpm --dir apps/indexer-monitor test
